report.summary: Reviewed the whole diff at 8f23c85. CI cache pruning: decides 'changed' from file times against a marker touched after restore; prunes only when every check passed and every run summary decodes, otherwise removes nothing; the save step depends on it. ci.ts runs each check in its own process group (SIGTERM at the deadline, SIGKILL when the check ends). deploy-worker now always builds with Docker, greps the image's tempod for the build id (fails closed) and pins the pushed digest; the CA secret is optional and the Dockerfile handles it absent. The config.ts change matches bun --env inlining of process.env.X; turbo.json already declares TEMPO_BUILD_ID. The forge demo test uses existing protocol RPCs and matches spec 10 and the server code (reopening a merged PR gives PR_NOT_MERGEABLE). Docs are updated in the same change. No blocking findings. I could not run typecheck, tests or a process-group probe (approval needed), so the Bun detached-group behavior and Effect 4 Schema.decodeUnknownOption are unverified.

findings.text: The default e2e config matches every spec, so `bun run test:e2e` gate runs now include forge-demo.spec.ts. Each run creates a permanent `tempo-demo-<tag>` repository, multiplied by E2E_REPEAT, with up to a 60-minute timeout. Probably intended, since the README lists it, but it adds deployment clutter and time to gate runs.

evidence.why: The new test:demo script is not the only entry point; the main test script also picks up the demo.

findings.text: Outside a git checkout the build id falls back to the package version, so the new tempod build-id grep passes even when tempod reports pkg.version (the fallback this change set out to catch).

evidence.why: When there is no sha, buildId equals the version string, which a pkg.version fallback in tempod also contains.

findings.text: Relies on Bun.spawn `detached: true` starting a new process group so that process.kill(-pid) reaches it. If Bun 1.4.2 does not call setsid, the kill throws ESRCH, the error is swallowed, and orphan cleanup comes back with no error shown. Not verified here; the CI log ('Cleaning up orphan processes' time) or a one-line pgid probe would confirm it.

evidence.quote: const child = Bun.spawn(cmd, { stdin: "inherit", stdout: "inherit", stderr: "inherit", detached: true });
evidence.why: killGroup's catch hides failure of the group kill.

checked.risk: Real contracts (Turbo cache layout and run summaries, actions/cache, bun --env inlining, Docker image, protocol RPCs for the demo)
Failure paths (prune fails closed on unreadable summaries or failed checks; deploy build-id check; swallowed kill errors)
Idempotency and state (cache save only when new entries exist; reruns of the deploy; PR reopen after merge)
Security (CA secret stays a BuildKit secret mount; no secrets in docker run or logs)
Build and runtime environment (grep present in the Debian base, tempod path, process groups in CI)
Tests (pure ci-cache unit tests run by scripts/test.ts; e2e demo waits on observable state with waitFor)
Spec (10 Project CI ingestion, merge gate, revision 0; 09 merged PRs cannot reopen; CI.md and deployment docs updated)
